question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Count the exported symbol names of the Mach-O image. Submit the count in base 10.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: python3 -c "import lief, sys; b = lief.parse('pg_macho.dylib'); n = [s.name for s in b.exported_symbols]; sys.stdout.write(''.join(x + chr(10) for x in n)); sys.stdout.flush()" 2>/dev/null | wc -l
